turns.q: Can it arrive gift-ready, and how fast can it ship?
turns.replyText:
Digital gift cards are delivered by email, so there’s no shipping time.

If you’re ordering a physical item, US shipping options are:
- Standard Shipping (3–7 business days)
- 2 business days (order by 3pm ET)
- 1 business day (order by 3pm ET)
- UPS Saturday Delivery (available at checkout only in a limited window)
- Same Day Delivery (LA only, order by 12pm PT)

You can see the full details here: [Shipping Options](https://www.fashionnova.com/pages/shipping-options).

turns.q: If they want to exchange it, how would that work?
turns.replyText:
Fashion Nova doesn’t do direct exchanges. They’d return the item (unworn, unused, tags attached) within 30 days of delivery for store credit as an e-gift card, then place a new order for the size or style they want (inventory isn’t reserved).

They can start a return here: [Fashion Nova Returns Portal](https://returns.fashionnova.com/fashionnova/returns).
